subject: Fix build on mac by using correct format specifier (#92)
reason: The change only replaces %lx/%lu with %llx/%llu in two ValkeyModule_Log(IOError) format strings to fix compilation on macOS, where uint64_t is unsigned long long. It alters no command behaviour, replies, data, or persistence format — only the text of a log line, and on the 64-bit Linux CI platform even that output is byte-identical since unsigned long and unsigned long long are both 64 bits. A build/portability fix with no observable runtime behaviour change needs no scenario.
